title: PlunderPixels Shader - Reimagined
description: Revived and reimagined from over a decade, a cutting edge gorgeous and immersive shaderpack.
body:
# PlunderPixels Shaders - Reimagined

**The shader you remember, back from the dead after more than a decade, and better than it has ever been.**

Years ago, PlunderPixels gave countless worlds their glow. Then it went quiet. Now it is back, rebuilt from the ground up by its original creator and re-engineered for modern Minecraft on the latest OptiFine and Iris. Same soul, brand new engine. Everything you loved is here, and everything that felt dated is gone.

This is not a re-upload. It is a top-to-bottom rebuild, in active development, with frequent updates and genuinely cutting-edge features landing all the time.

## Water like you have never seen in a legacy pack

- **Organic, reflective water.** The surface rolls with natural, wandering waves and mirrors the sky and the world around it. Clear looking straight down, a true mirror at a grazing angle.
- **Real caustics.** Sunlight caustics ripple across the shallow floor, projected from the sun's actual angle so they slide as the day turns, fading in the shade and with depth.
- **Underwater light shafts.** Dive under and shafts of light spear down through the water, toward the sun by day and the moon by night, cut off wherever a shadow falls. Murky water catches more of them, and at night you can still see up to the surface and the sky.
- **A dark, mirror-still night ocean** that catches the moon, the stars and the whole Milky Way on its surface.

## A sky worth looking up at

- **True volumetric clouds.** Soft, puffy 3D cumulus with real depth and self-shadowing, drifting on the wind. Warm sunlit tops, soft shadowed undersides, and clear blue gaps between them.
- **A dense night sky.** A custom, seam-free sky with a Milky Way packed with stars like a deep-field photograph, brighter toward the core, twinkling and wheeling overhead through the night.

## Everything you expect from a modern shader

- **Real soft sun shadows** that ground everything to the world, with adjustable softness and depth.
- **Full PBR (labPBR).** Drop in a PBR resource pack for deep normal-mapped detail, per-material reflectivity, ambient occlusion in the crevices, and true emissive blocks that glow on their own.
- **Cinematic light.** Filmic tonemapping, warm and cool grading, volumetric godrays, HDR bloom and lens flare.
- **A living, breathing world.** Grass, crops, leaves and flowers sway in a shared wind and stay rooted at the base like real plants.
- **Tune everything.** Nearly every look is a live in-game slider. Dial the mood, the shadows, the water, the clouds and the glow without editing a file.

## Frequent updates

PlunderPixels is being actively pushed forward. Water, sky and lighting get real, visible upgrades on a regular cadence, and new features are always in the pipeline. Follow the project to catch each drop.

## Companion mods in development

PlunderPixels is growing beyond the shader itself. A set of lightweight, client-side companion mods is currently in development, built to unlock effects a shader cannot pull off on its own and push the visuals even further. They are made by the same creator to drop straight into the pack, with no server changes needed. Follow the project to catch them as they land.

## Requirements

- Minecraft Java Edition with a recent **OptiFine**, or **Iris + Sodium**
- Works across the current 1.21 range on both loaders
- A **PBR (labPBR)** resource pack is optional but recommended to see the full normal, specular and emissive detail

Welcome back to PlunderPixels.
